summary: Tucked away within an exclusive and highly desirable cul-de-sac in the prestigious West End of Darlington, this outstanding and extended three-bedroom family home presents an opportunity to acquire a property of genuine quality, space, and refinement.
description:
Perfectly positioned to enjoy a peaceful residential setting whilst remaining conveniently close to an excellent range of local amenities, highly regarded schools, and Darlington town centre, the home also benefits from superb transport connectivity, with the A1(M) easily accessible for commuters. Having been thoughtfully extended and comprehensively improved by the current owners, the property has been carefully designed to enhance both space and functionality, creating a home that effortlessly caters to modern family living. The extension has transformed the ground floor, delivering a generous and sociable kitchen space, while the first floor has been reconfigured to create an impressive principal suite complete with dressing area and a well-appointed en suite. Throughout, the property has been maintained and presented to a high standard, with a clear attention to detail and a warm, inviting atmosphere evident in every room. The welcoming entrance hall immediately sets the tone, offering a sense of space and flow as it leads through to the heart of the home. The open-plan lounge and dining area is particularly striking, providing a beautifully proportioned living space bathed in natural light. French doors open directly onto the rear garden, seamlessly blending indoor and outdoor living and creating an ideal setting for both relaxed family time and entertaining guests. A separate study offers a quiet and versatile space, perfectly suited for home working or as a snug or playroom. The kitchen has been thoughtfully extended to create a truly functional and stylish space, fitted with a range of quality units and integrated appliances, along with generous work surfaces and storage. Its layout is designed with both practicality and social living in mind, making it the perfect hub of the home. Additional ground floor features include a convenient WC and internal access to the integral garage, further enhancing everyday ease and usability. To the first floor, the sense of quality and space continues. The principal bedroom is a standout feature, offering a calm and luxurious retreat, complete with a dedicated dressing area and a contemporary en suite. The remaining bedrooms are well-proportioned and versatile, ideal for family members or guests, and are complemented by a modern family bathroom finished in a tasteful and neutral style. Externally, the property continues to impress with beautifully maintained gardens to both the front and rear. The rear garden provides a private and tranquil outdoor space, perfect for relaxation, entertaining, or family enjoyment, while the front offers a neat and attractive approach. A driveway provides off-road parking and leads to the integral garage, completing the practicality of this exceptional home. This is a property that truly stands out for its space, presentation, and location. Early viewing is essential to fully appreciate the lifestyle opportunity on offer within one of Darlington's most sought-after residential settings.

ENTRANCE HALLWAY The entrance hall is accessed via a stylish composite door featuring glazed panels, allowing for an abundance of natural light, further enhanced by a UPVC framed double glazed window to the side. This welcoming space retains a sense of character with original flooring underfoot and benefits from a useful understairs storage cupboard. Additional features include a radiator, decorative ceiling coving, and a staircase rising to the first floor, setting an impressive tone for the rest of the home.

OPEN PLAN LOUNGE / DINING ROOM The open-plan lounge and dining room offers generous and versatile living accommodation, ideal for both everyday family life and entertaining. To the front aspect, a UPVC framed double glazed leaded bay window allows an abundance of natural light to fill the space, creating a bright and welcoming atmosphere. A striking wall-mounted marble fire surround with contrasting hearth houses a dual fuel fire, providing a stunning focal point and a cosy, homely feel. Further features include a radiator for comfort, decorative ceiling coving, and an elegant ceiling rose, all contributing to the room's character and charm while maintaining a refined and well-presented finish throughout. The dining area continues the sense of space and flow, featuring a further radiator for comfort and UPVC framed double glazed French doors opening directly onto the rear garden, seamlessly connecting indoor and outdoor living. Decorative ceiling coving and ceiling rose complete the room, enhancing its character and overall presentation.

STUDY The study is a highly versatile and well-proportioned space, ideal for home working or use as a snug or playroom. It benefits from a range of built-in storage units, providing excellent practicality, along with space for a desk. The room features laminate flooring, a radiator, and a UPVC framed double glazed window allowing for natural light. With access through to the kitchen, enhancing the flow of the ground floor accommodation.

KITCHEN/BREAKFAST ROOM The kitchen is comprehensively fitted with a range of modern base and wall units, complemented by granite work surfaces and an inset sink unit with drainer and mixer tap. The space is finished with tiling to the splashback and work areas, creating a practical and stylish working environment. A full suite of integrated appliances includes a fridge freezer, slimline dishwasher, double oven, large induction hob with overhead extractor, and a useful warming drawer. The kitchen also offers ample space for a dining table and chairs, making it a highly functional family hub. Additional features include a radiator, laminate flooring, a UPVC framed double glazed window providing natural light, and a UPVC framed double glazed door leading externally. There is also an integral door providing direct access into the garage, further enhancing convenience and practicality.

GROUND FLOOR WC The ground floor WC is fitted with a white suite comprising a wash hand basin and WC. The room benefits from tiling to splash areas and a vanity unit, providing both practicality and a clean, modern finish.

FIRST FLOOR LANDING The first floor landing is a particularly generous and versatile space, currently utilised as a quiet seating area ideal for peaceful reading or relaxation, but equally suitable for a variety of alternative uses such as a study nook or additional living space. It benefits from a UPVC framed double glazed window providing natural light, a radiator, and loft access with a pull-down ladder, offering further practicality and storage potential.

BEDROOM ONE Bedroom one is situated within the extension and is a particularly spacious principal bedroom, offering ample room for a range of bedroom furniture along with a dedicated dressing area. The room is enhanced by a UPVC framed double glazed leaded window allowing for natural light, along with a radiator for comfort. Additional features include decorative ceiling coving and a ceiling rose, adding character and elegance to the space. A door provides direct access to the en suite, completing this impressive principal suite.

EN SUITE The en suite is stylishly appointed and fitted with a modern white suite comprising a spacious double walk-in shower cubicle with inset electric shower, a wash hand basin, and a WC. The shower area provides a generous and comfortable space, creating a practical yet contemporary feel. The room benefits from part-tiled walls, adding both texture and ease of maintenance, while a UPVC framed double glazed window allows for natural light and ventilation, enhancing the bright and airy atmosphere. A radiator provides warmth and comfort, and the laminate flooring offers a sleek, durable finish that complements the overall modern styling of the space.

BEDROOM TWO Bedroom two is a generously proportioned double bedroom, offering ample space for a range of bedroom furniture, making it a comfortable and versatile room. It benefits from a UPVC framed double glazed leaded window, allowing natural light to fill the space, along with a radiator providing warmth and comfort throughout the year.

BEDROOM THREE Bedroom three is another well-proportioned double bedroom, offering ample space for a range of bedroom furniture and providing a versatile living arrangement suitable for family use, guests, or home working if required. The room benefits from a UPVC framed double glazed window allowing natural light to flow in, along with a radiator ensuring year-round comfort.

FAMILY BATHROOM The family bathroom is fitted with a stylish white suite comprising a separate shower cubicle with inset electric shower, a panelled bath, and a wash hand basin, offering both convenience and flexibility for modern family living. The shower enclosure provides a practical and easy-access option, while the bath creates a perfect space for relaxation. The room is finished with part-tiled walls, adding a clean and contemporary feel while ensuring ease of maintenance, complemented by durable laminate flooring underfoot. A UPVC framed double glazed window allows for natural light and ventilation, enhancing the bright and airy atmosphere. A radiator provides warmth and comfort, completing this well-appointed and functional family bathroom.

EXTERNALLY Externally, to the frontage, the property enjoys an attractive and well-presented block paved driveway providing off-road parking for up to two vehicles, which in turn leads directly to the garage with a roller up and over door. The front garden is neatly maintained, featuring a shaped lawn bordered by mature and well-established flowerbeds, planted with a variety of colourful seasonal flora and ornamental shrubbery, creating a welcoming and characterful first impression of the home. Gated side access leads through to the rear garden, which is a particularly impressive and thoughtfully landscaped outdoor space. Fully fence enclosed to provide a good degree of privacy, the rear garden has been designed with both relaxation and entertaining in mind. There are paved patio seating areas ideal for outdoor dining and social gatherings, seamlessly leading onto a well-tended lawn that forms the central feature of the garden. Surrounding the lawn are established and stocked flowerbeds, enhanced with a variety of trees, shrubs, and planting, offering colour, texture, and interest throughout the year. Further enhancing the appeal of this outdoor space is a charming garden pond, adding a peaceful focal point, along with practical additions including log stores and a large garden shed, providing excellent external storage. Overall, the garden offers a rare combination of space and privacy, making it a true extension of the living accommodation.
